subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The class then studied their own school trash for one day, wearing gloves and recording categories.”?
options: They found that many were in neighborhoods with more older residents.
But after a week, many students found that starting was the hardest part.
They found food waste, plastic wrappers, paper, and many unfinished drinks.
Plastic bottles, food wrappers, fishing lines, and cigarette boxes were written down.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The class then studied their own school trash for one day, wearing gloves and recording categories. They found food waste, plastic wrappers, paper, and…」，答案為「They found food waste, plastic wrappers, paper, and many unfinished drinks.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They found food waste, plastic wrappers, paper, and many unfinished drinks.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
